name: Monochrome
source:
Kirioka Taiki lost his memories the day his parents died. The amnesiac young man may have met his savior when he came across the angel in training. In one month, Taiki met with an array of girls who knows bits of his past, talk to them, ask them on dates, get to know them and get to know yourself.

[From [url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-70-3ph6.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
translation:
双亲离世的那一天，桐丘大辉也一并失去了过往的记忆。直到邂逅一位见习天使少女，这名失忆青年或许终于迎来了救赎的契机。在短短一个月的时间里，大辉将陆续结识多位知晓他往昔点滴线索的少女——去与她们交谈、邀她们约会，在走近少女们内心的同时，一步步找回真正的自己吧。

[摘自[url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-70-3ph6.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
